question_text: Which of the following sorting algorithms has the best average-case time complexity?
explanation: Merge Sort has a time complexity of O(n log n) in all cases (best, average, worst).

question_text: What is the primary purpose of an index in a relational database?
option_b: To speed up data retrieval operations
explanation: Database indexing creates a lookup structure to significantly accelerate search queries.

question_text: In Process Management, which condition is NOT necessary for a deadlock to occur?
explanation: The four necessary conditions for deadlock are Mutual Exclusion, Hold and Wait, No Preemption, and Circular Wait.

question_text: Which layer in the OSI model is responsible for end-to-end communication and error recovery?
explanation: The Transport Layer (e.g., TCP) ensures reliable end-to-end transmission and error recovery.

question_text: Which Object-Oriented Programming concept allows a child class to provide a specific implementation of a method defined in its parent class?
explanation: Method Overriding allows a subclass to override a method of its superclass.
